verdict.rationale: Token2 documents PIV support via a Windows miniDriver and macOS Companion App enabling smartcard-based certificate enrollment and login with on-prem AD, which covers workstation sign-in use cases. However, there is no evidence for VPN integration or code signing use cases specifically, nor independent/hands-on verification of PIV certificate workflows beyond vendor docs. missing for 10: VPN certificate-auth evidence, code-signing use case evidence, independent/hands-on validation of PIV smartcard login, detail on key non-exportability guarantees for PIV certs.
